_meta.description: Crosstab of mean revenue by region x segment (an AGG_AVERAGE cell) decorated with an OVERLAY_DELTA_VS_MARGIN cell overlay: cell - row margin, in the cell's own units. The row margin of a mean cell is the region's mean revenue, so each figure is how far a segment sits above or below its region's average (segment_b about +15 to +20 in three regions). Additive sibling of OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_MARGIN (01_crosstab_index_vs_margin.json); ref.margin.axis takes row, column or grand. On a count cell the row margin is the row total, so every delta is negative. Buffered; renderers centre colour ramps on baseline 0.
_meta.name: crosstab-delta-vs-margin
